description: Get a non-custodial cross-chain bridge quote (Across) between Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, and Robinhood (4663). Returns unsigned transaction data — the depositor wallet signs and broadcasts. Free with X-ORKID-API-Key header or $0.002 USDC/call via x402.

amount.description: Amount in base units (integer string), e.g. "25000000" for 25 USDC

depositor.description: Depositor 0x address — the wallet that will sign

inputToken.description: Input token symbol or address on the origin chain

outputToken.description: Output token symbol or address on the destination chain

name: orkid_bridge_quote
title: Orkid Bridge Quote
